The Tennessee Titans' leak is the right side at 8.34 yards per attempt on 29 throws and 8 gains of 20-plus on 64 attempts; their middle is a better 7.0 YPA and their run defense is the sturdy unit at 3.59 YPC.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for the Tennessee Titans or the New York Giants, so no injury-driven shift is priced in this TEN@NYG game: Tony Pollard stays on 21 carries, Tyjae Spears on 10 carries and 6 targets, and Cam Skattebo on 30 carries and only 4 targets.
